How a top-up works

  1. Copy our detailsOur InstaPay address, and your email for the transfer note.
  2. Send it with InstaPayAny amount from the minimum up; you see your Cotton before you confirm.
  3. Tell us you paidThe date, the amount and the InstaPay address you paid from. We add your Cotton.

Payments are checked by hand. Don’t send another transfer while one is being reviewed. Help: hello@lightningeg.com

Payment and purchase terms

Coins are credits for Lightning cosmetics. Top-ups and cosmetic purchases are final; discretionary refunds are not offered. Mandatory legal rights and manual review of duplicate transfers, payment errors or failed delivery remain available. Your financial app data stays on your devices.

Send the amount once, with your Lightning account email as the transfer note. We add your Cotton after we see the money arrive in our account. Contact support before sending more money while a payment is being checked.

We check every payment by hand. Allow one working day after the money arrives for your Cotton.
